# Working agreement

## Context and authority

This synthetic project is a local text formatter maintained by one owner. Preserve its small offline footprint. The owner confirms intent and consequential scope, cost or risk; agents choose routine engineering methods and checks. Scoped inspection, edits and safe checks are permitted. Only bounded independent read-only Standards and Spec reviewers may be delegated; other workers require approval. Finite assignments and independent reports are required. Reviewers neither edit nor recursively delegate.

The user selects stages. Offer next actions without starting them; explicit compound requests may select several. When a tracker is configured, spec/ticket commands select scoped publication without another full-text approval of unchanged commitments; draft/local/review requests override this. New consequential commitments and relationship mutations still require exact approval. This project has no tracker, so remote publication is unavailable, not a reason to block local planning or delivery. Publication alone proves no readiness.

Git operations require separate approval here. Delivery returns results before PR preparation/publication, regardless of any later branch/push permission. Selected PR work reuses current evidence. Merge and release remain separate.

## Safety and checks

Preserve unrelated bytes, index state, modes, links and history. Unknown permission is ungranted; destruction, sensitive disclosure, spending, installation, credentials, merge, deployment and release need specific approval. Auxiliary model assessments and service startup are prohibited; ordinary reviewer agents are distinct. No policy upgrade changes these restrictions.

Choose checks by meaningful failure risk and inspect raw results. Material failed/missing checks or unresolved material findings block acceptance. Refresh affected checks and independent Standards/Spec review after significant repairs against full delivered dirty scope. Keep finding lineage and spent allowance across methods, workers and resume; at most two automatic repair cycles per acceptance checkpoint, never reset by transfer.

Discover actual needed companions, read complete entries and relevant references, verify source identity/semantic compatibility, recover truncated reads and resolve links from their containing file. Missing helpers block their route without installation or silent fallback.

## Documentation and continuation

Maintain changed authoritative documentation and confirmed authorized domain meanings during the responsible work. No domain terms, ADRs or release history currently need records; create none merely for setup. ADR creation/supersession requires explicit agreement and permission, preserving rationale and history. Report documentation impact and real verification limits.

Same-session evidence can stay in conversation; persist only when and where requested. Do not manufacture handoffs or durable reports for a possible session end. Active owners, uncertain operations and spent repair/model allowances remain safety obligations; inspect them before replacement/retry. A later session cannot invent unavailable history.
